title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E22: R4 Public Reproducibility & Fresh Checkout Audit Protocol
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4
scientific_unit: fresh git clone checkout execution pass

primary_endpoints.name: Checksum Concordance
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of generated experiment artifacts matching frozen SHA-256 release checksums.

primary_endpoints.name: Claim Reproducibility Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of empirical claims in R4 manuscript exactly reproduced upon clean checkout execution.

secondary_endpoints.name: Execution Time Reproducibility
secondary_endpoints.definition: Ratio of re-execution total runtime relative to baseline reference execution.

sample_size.unit_definition: 1 complete hermetic offline reproduction pass from fresh git clone checkout verifying 100% of R4 experiments

reproduction_steps: 1. Environment verification and Python/PostgreSQL dependency validation
2. Verification of frozen commit SHAs and protocol JSON SHA256 checksums
3. Automated re-execution of E15 through E21 experiment runners
4. Exact binary/statistical output comparison against frozen baseline
5. Automated generation of R4 Publication Audit Report

statistical_plan.method: Hermetic Clean-Checkout Automated Re-Execution and Bit-Exact Checksum Audit (100% Offline Verification)

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Disallow public claim release if any reproduction checksum or classification outcome fails (Gate 5).
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Any missing raw execution log file or checksum mismatch triggers immediate verification failure.
